verdict.rationale: An AI-insights feature is a fair question for a SaaS sales-tax platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions. The economic nexus tracking tool is a rule-based threshold report, an adjacent feature rather than AI-generated insight, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
